hierarchy.algorithm: Kruskal maximum-spanning forest over the frozen undirected non-negative surface affinity
hierarchy.edge_order: descending affinity, then ascending canonical primitive-row endpoint pair
hierarchy.reciprocal_rule: single-sided or reciprocal undirected storage is accepted, but repeated endpoint pairs must have exactly equal affinity
hierarchy.merge_rule: every successful union creates one binary parent; disconnected components remain separate roots
hierarchy.determinism: input edge position is never a tie-break
hierarchy.scalability_implementation: directed endpoint pairs are encoded into vectorized int64 canonical keys; NumPy sorting, adjacent exact-affinity validation, and boolean unique compaction replace per-edge Python tuples/dictionaries; DSU state and hierarchy arrays are contiguous NumPy arrays
hierarchy.connected_fast_exit: Kruskal stops after N-1 successful unions because no later dense edge can alter a connected hierarchy

sealed_hierarchy_probability.positive_seed_leaf: an observed leaf with m_positive greater than m_negative
sealed_hierarchy_probability.candidate_nodes: the deduplicated union of every positive seed leaf and every ancestor on its fixed hierarchy chain
sealed_hierarchy_probability.leaf_proposal_probability: h_i=max over candidate ancestors A containing i of r_A; the maximum over an empty set is zero
sealed_hierarchy_probability.multi_branch_operator: maximum; it is bounded, idempotent, and cannot inflate probability merely because duplicate branches name the same ancestor
sealed_hierarchy_probability.unobserved_rule: zero source mass contributes neither positive nor negative responsibility

source_fusion.q_obs: m_positive/(m_positive+m_negative) on observed rows and canonical neutral 0.5 otherwise
source_fusion.confidence: finite c_obs in [0,1], exactly zero on unobserved rows

source_only_selection.fold_unit: caller-sealed source-raster footprint block or complete hierarchy-subtree group
source_only_selection.group_assignment: SplitMix64(group_id) modulo 3; a group is never split
source_only_selection.heldout_clear: positive and negative prompt responsibility are exact zero on the complete heldout group before the field callback and hierarchy construction
audits: fixed ten-bin responsibility-weighted expected calibration error
source_only_selection.base_fail_safe: the hierarchy arm is selected only when its complete lexicographic rank strictly beats the field base

fail_closed: all tensors must be CPU resident and shape aligned
all masses must be finite and non-negative
all probabilities must be finite and in [0,1]
q_obs must replay the exact responsibility fraction within fixed floating-point tolerance
source content, hierarchy content, graph authority, source authority, and fold-unit authority are checked
OOF decisions cannot be applied to different hierarchy or source content

tests.compatibility: 23 passed across hierarchy completion, query-specific propagation CV, and source-observation evidence gate
covered_gates: reciprocal affinity and graph authority rejection
group-preserving folds and exact heldout clearing
hierarchy-arm selection when source OOF improves
final source fusion and OOF provenance rejection

integration_decision: core implementation is ready for a separate frozen evaluator adapter; this closure itself performs no benchmark prediction or target access
